title: Custom Web Browser (Version 2)
overview:
The NetLink Custom Web Browser takes your Sega Saturn online. Plug the NetLink Internet Modem into the cartridge slot, connect it to a phone line, insert this disc and turn on the console to browse the World Wide Web and send email on your TV.

The browser smooths text for easy reading on a television screen and works with the internet service provider of your choice. Navigate with the control pad, or add the NetLink Keyboard and NetLink Mouse for faster typing and pointing.
